subject.title: Discord turns can be missed or finish silently across gateway restart/recovery on 2026.6.10

question: Should this composite v2026.6.10 Discord restart report remain open as the live reliability tracker, or should maintainers split its evidence into the existing inbound catch-up, final-delivery, send_attempt_started, and cron/task recovery trackers?
rationale: The source proves overlapping gaps, but safe behavior requires a human decision about replay semantics, duplicate-send risk, provider-owned catch-up defaults, and whether one issue should coordinate multiple owner boundaries.
